name: Icon & Favicon Generator
blurb: every icon size and the manifest entries from one image
intro: Lists every icon file a web app, Android app or iOS app needs from one source image, with the logo sized to each platform's safe zone (maskable 80 % circle, Android 66 dp circle, Apple 20 px margin). It writes the HTML <link> tags, manifest entries, Android XML, iOS Contents.json and an ImageMagick script that makes the files.

inputs.label: Source file
inputs.help: An SVG is best; a PNG should be 1024 px or more.

inputs.label: Source width
inputs.help: For an SVG: its viewBox width (sets the render density).

inputs.label: Background colour
inputs.help: Fills maskable, Apple and iOS icons (they must be opaque).

examples.title: A PWA from an SVG logo
Web, Android and iOS from a 1024 px round PNG

usage: Give the source file name, its width in px, the logo shape (square, circle, wide, tall), app name, short name, background and theme colours as #hex, the URL prefix, and booleans web/android/ios (iosSet single or full). Returns a table of every file with its pixel size and the logo size inside it, and texts: HTML head tags, manifest.webmanifest, Android adaptive XML, iOS Contents.json and an ImageMagick 7 shell script. It does not read the image itself; run the script to make the files.
sources: W3C Web App Manifest, icon purpose "maskable" (safe zone: circle of radius 40 %)
Evil Martians, "How to Favicon in 2024: Six files that fit most needs"
Android Developers, "Adaptive icons" (108 dp layers, 72 dp visible, 66 dp safe zone) and launcher density buckets
Apple Human Interface Guidelines, "App icons" (single 1024 px icon, no transparency)
